input: Quick one: does MCP require servers to support both stdio and Streamable HTTP transports? Point me at the spec.
output:
No. The spec defines two standard transports, stdio and Streamable HTTP, but a server only has to implement the ones it chooses to offer; there is no requirement to support both. The normative wording is that clients SHOULD support stdio whenever possible, and servers MAY offer either or both (custom transports are allowed too, as long as they preserve the JSON-RPC message format and the lifecycle). Iris, for example, is stdio by default and only adds HTTP with --transport http.

Spec section: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/spec/transports/requirements
